inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev13 VERTEBRATE, dev12 UNKNOWN, dev11 BUTTERFLY, dev10 HORNET, dev9 ULTIMATE UFO, dev8 MANDALA and earlier native-format/mod/source-only gates remain inherited. Dev14 resolves CENTIPEDE initial-combat assembly and evidence-bounded later topology.

centipede_runtime_assembly.body_cut_rule: newly exposed chain ends become head/tail roles and therefore A0 display
centipede_runtime_assembly.endpoint_destroy_rule: enters reset/reform path rather than producing a canonical static split pose
centipede_runtime_assembly.final_phase_boundary: survivors become independent A0 movers with runtime-randomized destinations; no static preset is invented
centipede_runtime_assembly.cross_platform: retail Xbox + June 10 Xbox + retail PS3 preserve 32-link radius-80/11.25-degree ring and <6-survivor threshold

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, independently source-audited before executing package code, then passed 96/96 selftests plus CLI/GUI version and CENTIPEDE initial-ring checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this evidence.

limitations: Only the deterministic initial CENTIPEDE ring is published as a static assembly; combat splits/reformation and the <=5-survivor final phase depend on damage topology and/or runtime-randomized destinations.
Fresh retail Xbox game data and the project-owner screenshot were used only for external validation/corroboration; no proprietary package, GMX, screenshot or generated retail glTF is bundled.
Native SIIG coordinate scale is preserved; no speculative meter conversion or hidden display scaling is applied.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary fully original synthesized scenes remains a separate emulator/hardware gate.
Platform shader microcode compilation and remaining opaque GMX semantics remain unresolved.
Compressed/mipmapped native texture variants are not synthesized.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
